Welcome to the Groveland Town Clerk’s Office
The Groveland Town Clerk’s Office serves as a central hub for many of the Town’s official and legal functions. As the official keeper of municipal records, our office plays a vital role in maintaining transparency, upholding local and state laws, and providing essential services to residents, local boards, and municipal departments.
Hours of Operation
Monday 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
Tuesday – Thursday 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Friday 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
Our Responsibilities Include:
Vital Records & Licensing
We maintain and issue certified copies of birth, death, and marriage records for Groveland residents. The office also issues various licenses and permits, including:
Dog licenses
Business certificates
Raffle permits
Yard Sale permits
Marriage licenses
Elections & Voter Services
As the Town’s chief election official, the Clerk's Office oversees all local, state, and federal elections. We manage:
Voter registration
Polling locations and election officers
Early voting and vote-by-mail options
Nomination papers and campaign finance filings
Certification of election results
The Town Clerk also serves on the Board of Registrars and ensures the integrity of the voting process.
Town Meetings & Civic Records
We organize and support all Town Meetings, assisting with preparation of voting lists, attendance, vote counts, and accurate record-keeping. Following Town Meeting, we file bylaw changes with the Massachusetts Attorney General for approval.
Public Records & Transparency
Our office is responsible for posting all official meeting notices in accordance with the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law. Notices must be posted at least 48 hours in advance on the Town website and the official board located outside the Town Clerk’s Office in Town Hall. We also respond to public records requests and serve as custodians for the Town's bylaws, legal notices, and other permanent municipal documents.
Oaths of Office & Ethics Compliance
We administer oaths of office to all elected and appointed officials, and maintain related records. The Clerk's Office ensures annual compliance with State Ethics Law, including the documentation of disclosures and training acknowledgments.
Annual Town Census
Each January, we conduct the Town’s annual street listing/census by mailing a form to every household. The data collected helps determine Groveland’s eligibility for certain types of state funding and keeps our voter registration lists accurate.
Our Mission
The Groveland Town Clerk’s Office is committed to delivering professional, courteous, and efficient service to all. We uphold the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts and the bylaws of the Town of Groveland while continuously striving for best practices in public administration. We are proud to serve with integrity, ensuring that every interaction is handled with respect, accuracy, and transparency.
